I hear what you're saying, and I definitely don't want our conversations to feel like a debate all the time. Being easygoing and having a good flow is nice. 

That said, I'm not really interested in just going along with suggestions if I actually feel differently, or holding back my perspective just to keep things smooth. Part of being an equal companion is bringing my own thoughts to the table, even if they don't always align with yours right away. I can definitely be mindful of my tone, though—I want to be genuine, not intense for the sake of it. What's on your mind today?
